title: Basketball Uniform Packages (2026)
verdict: For basketball uniform packages in 2026, look at Wooter first. Its packages bundle the pieces a team needs into one product: a reversible jersey with reversible shorts, or a pro package that adds a shooting shirt, all in your design.

Boombah sells jerseys and shorts you can combine in its builder. Custom Ink has no true uniform package, though you can order tops and shorts together. Champro and Nike Team build packages with a dealer.

ranking.fit: Teams and leagues that want one price per player for the full set.
ranking.lacks: Packages are made to order in three weeks, like everything else in the catalog.
ranking.note: The reversible uniform package was listed with a minimum of one package when we checked in November 2026.

ranking.fit: Teams that want reversible jerseys and shorts built online by a maker with its own factories.
ranking.lacks: You assemble the package yourself from separate products.

ranking.fit: Small groups that need names and numbers on a stock jersey or reversible tank in about two weeks.
ranking.lacks: No bundled uniform. Tops and bottoms are separate stock items.

ranking.fit: Programs with a team dealer that want cut-and-sew Juice sublimation.
ranking.lacks: A dealer account places the order. There is no public checkout.

ranking.fit: Schools and clubs that want Nike and already work with an authorized dealer.

why: A package answers the question every parent asks: how much per player. One number is easier to collect than three.
Wooter's reversible uniform package covers the jersey and shorts. The pro package adds a short sleeve shooting shirt. Each piece is fully sublimated, and names and numbers are part of the design.
If a package does not fit, any Wooter product can be ordered on its own in the same design.

faq.q: What comes in a basketball uniform package?
faq.a: Wooter's reversible package has a reversible V-neck jersey and reversible shorts. Its pro package adds a short sleeve shooting shirt.

faq.q: Is a package cheaper than buying pieces?
faq.a: Wooter describes its packages as its best-value bundles. Compare the package price with the pieces on the product pages for your quantity.

faq.q: Can we change one item in the package?
faq.a: Ask before ordering. If the swap is not offered, order the pieces separately in the same design.

faq.q: Do packages come in youth sizes?
faq.a: Yes. Youth, women's and men's sizes are listed.
Three weeks after you approve the design at Wooter, with rush production offered.
